steps.action:
You're right to be cautious, and I understand your hesitation about resetting settings and rebooting. Rest assured, resetting your APN settings to default is a standard troubleshooting step and won't delete any of your personal data or pictures. It simply restores the connection settings your phone uses to talk to the network.

Even though you see an MMSC URL, sometimes these settings can become corrupted or be incorrect, preventing MMS from working. Resetting them will ensure your phone is using the carrier's official settings.

So yes, please proceed with resetting your APN settings to default. After that, you will need to reboot your phone for those changes to take effect. It's a crucial step in ensuring the new settings are fully applied.
